{{Quote|A corporate fleet was blockading Malastare, a fleet led by Trench.|Wullf Yularen|audio=AFleetLedByTrench-CaM.flac|<ref name="Cat and Mouse">{{TCW|Cat and Mouse}}</ref>}}
A '''fleet''' of the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]] was a [[Fleet/Legends|naval formation]] that [[Blockade/Legends|blockaded]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] during the [[Battle of Malastare Narrows/Legends|Battle of Malastare Narrows]] over a decade before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
The [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] was led by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Trench/Legends|Trench]], and using his tactics, it tore into the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] fleet sent to [[Battle of Malastare Narrows/Legends|engage]] the blockade. The Republic [[Starship/Legends|ships]] barely escaped the battle, and were later reinforced with a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-led task force that destroyed [[Trench's flagship/Legends|Trench's flagship]].
